items.title: Foundation (Class 6–12 NCERTs + Syllabus + PYQs)
tasks: Download the official syllabus & past 5 years' papers from UPSC Previous Exam Details.

Complete Class 6–12 NCERTs subject-wise (History → Geography → Polity → Economy → Science/Ecology → Society → Fine Arts) using the direct official links in Part 2, paired with the free video playlists where concepts feel dense.
Read The Hindu or The Indian Express (Explained) + PIB for 45–60 minutes daily without making bulky notes initially.

items.title: Standard Core + Optional Paper 1 & 2
tasks: Layer standard core books (Part 3) onto your NCERT base using free legal video companions (Atish Mathur / Bookstawa / Mrunal / Sudarshan Gurjar / PMF IAS) + PRS Bill Track + 2nd ARC Reports.
Complete your Optional syllabus using IGNOU eGyanKosh + e-PG Pathshala + free YouTube lectures (Part 10).
Start writing 1–2 daily Mains answers on InsightsIAS / ForumIAS / Drishti IAS and compare against Toppers' Answer Copies.

items.title: Prelims Intensive + CSAT + Current Affairs Consolidation
tasks: Switch to active MCQ solving: solve 2013–latest UPSC Prelims PYQs twice (Part 7), practice daily free quizzes, and revise monthly current affairs + Vision IAS PT 365 + Economic Survey + Union Budget.
Dedicate 1 hour/day to CSAT using NCERT Maths (Class 8–10) + UNGIST / Sleepy Classes free playlists + past CSAT papers (Part 9).

study_sequence.title: Foundation (Class 6–12 NCERTs + Syllabus + PYQs)
tasks: Download the official syllabus & past 5 years' papers from UPSC Previous Exam Details.

Complete Class 6–12 NCERTs subject-wise (History → Geography → Polity → Economy → Science/Ecology → Society → Fine Arts) using the direct official links in Part 2, paired with the free video playlists where concepts feel dense.
Read The Hindu or The Indian Express (Explained) + PIB for 45–60 minutes daily without making bulky notes initially.

study_sequence.title: Standard Core + Optional Paper 1 & 2
tasks: Layer standard core books (Part 3) onto your NCERT base using free legal video companions (Atish Mathur / Bookstawa / Mrunal / Sudarshan Gurjar / PMF IAS) + PRS Bill Track + 2nd ARC Reports.
Complete your Optional syllabus using IGNOU eGyanKosh + e-PG Pathshala + free YouTube lectures (Part 10).
Start writing 1–2 daily Mains answers on InsightsIAS / ForumIAS / Drishti IAS and compare against Toppers' Answer Copies.

study_sequence.title: Prelims Intensive + CSAT + Current Affairs Consolidation
tasks: Switch to active MCQ solving: solve 2013–latest UPSC Prelims PYQs twice (Part 7), practice daily free quizzes, and revise monthly current affairs + Vision IAS PT 365 + Economic Survey + Union Budget.
Dedicate 1 hour/day to CSAT using NCERT Maths (Class 8–10) + UNGIST / Sleepy Classes free playlists + past CSAT papers (Part 9).

study_sequence.title: Answer Writing, Ethics (GS-4), Essay & Mains 365
tasks: Practice timed 3-hour papers on official UPSC Specimen QCAB layout.
